# The edits' patterns

Every distinct pattern the pipeline's edits handed `crefactor/edit`'s windowed
matchers (`lines.go`) in one run of `whim build --check` over all the
phases, at the commit that introduced the matchers: 837 of them, one a line,
quoted as Go quotes a string.  `TestScopedPatterns` (`scoped_test.go`) runs
each on `src/slim-vim.c` and `src/whim-vim.c` both ways -- on the windows the
pattern's literal picks out, and as the regexp alone on the whole text --
and requires the same matches.  The list was logged by a hook the commit
does not keep; a new edit's pattern is not in it, and need not be: the
matchers are held to the regexp on any pattern, and this is the sample of
the shapes the edits write.

